metricDescriptions.cpu: CPU used by the host's main process, normalized across all cores.
metricDescriptions.memory: Resident memory of the host's main process.
metricDescriptions.diskIo: Combined disk read and write throughput across the app's process tree.
metricDescriptions.runtimeBusy: Share of time the async runtime's workers spent running tasks.
metricDescriptions.tasks: Async tasks currently alive in the runtime.
metricDescriptions.eventLoopUtilization: Share of time the Node event loop was busy rather than idle.
metricDescriptions.eventLoopDelay: How late timers fired — the 95th percentile event-loop delay.
metricDescriptions.nodeHeap: JavaScript heap in use by the Node host.
metricDescriptions.fps: Frames this window painted per second. Unmeasured while the window is hidden.
metricDescriptions.mainThreadBlocked: Share of each interval spent in long tasks (over 50 ms) that block input and rendering.
metricDescriptions.longTasks: Main-thread tasks longer than 50 ms in each interval.
metricDescriptions.jsHeap: JavaScript heap in use by this window.
metricDescriptions.longTaskMax: Longest main-thread task observed in this sampling interval.
metricDescriptions.longTaskBlocking: Sum of each observed long task’s duration beyond 50 ms in this interval. This is not Lighthouse Total Blocking Time.
metricDescriptions.heapUtilization: Used JavaScript heap divided by the browser-reported heap limit. Available only in supporting runtimes.
metricDescriptions.frameGapP95: 95th percentile of visible animation-frame gaps in this interval. Hidden-window time is excluded.
metricDescriptions.slowFrames: Number of observed visible frame gaps over 50 ms in this interval.
metricDescriptions.resourceCount: Number of resource timing entries observed in this interval; not a count of all network requests.
metricDescriptions.resourceDurationP95: 95th percentile of durations of resource timing entries observed in this interval.
metricDescriptions.resourceTransfer: Sum of browser-visible resource transfer bytes this interval. Cross-origin sizes may be hidden; this is not total network usage.
metricDescriptions.eventCount: Event Timing entries lasting at least 16 ms observed this interval. Not every interaction produces an entry.
metricDescriptions.inputDelayP95: 95th percentile of input delay among sampled Event Timing entries (at least 16 ms). This is not INP.
metricDescriptions.eventProcessingP95: 95th percentile of processing duration among sampled Event Timing entries (at least 16 ms).
metricDescriptions.operationCount: Instrumented operations completed in this interval, including failures and cancellations. Nested operations are counted separately.
metricDescriptions.operationDurationP95: 95th percentile of completed operation durations in this interval. Groups may overlap and have different timing boundaries; use Diagnose for per-operation details.
metricDescriptions.operationErrors: Instrumented operations that failed in this interval, including non-successful HTTP responses.
metricDescriptions.operationCancelled: Instrumented operations rejected with AbortError in this interval.
metricDescriptions.operationInFlight: Instrumented operations still in progress when this frame was sampled.

webVitals.title: Web Vitals
webVitals.description: Page loading, responsiveness and visual stability for this window. These are document-level measurements, not per-second samples or model response times. Values stay in memory for the current session.

collection.label: Collect Web Vitals
collection.description: Save the latest selected measurements locally in this window. Collection and reporting are off by default.

reporting.label: Report through telemetry
reporting.description: Allow new measurements through the existing telemetry pipeline. Behavior telemetry consent, the app category, sampling and destination settings must also allow delivery. Previously collected values are not replayed.

webVitals.loadError: Could not start Web Vitals collection. Reload this window to try again.
webVitals.persistenceError: Your choices apply to this page but could not be saved for your next visit. Turning collection off still takes effect immediately.
webVitals.lifecycleHint: Choices apply to this device or browser. Metrics cover the whole document, not individual routes, and may arrive after interaction or when hidden. Turning collection off stops recording and reporting immediately; Next.js observers remain until reload. Reload to begin a fresh measurement session after changing switches or clearing values.

LCP.label: LCP
LCP.description: Largest Contentful Paint · main content loading

CLS.label: CLS
CLS.description: Cumulative Layout Shift · unitless stability score

FCP.label: FCP
FCP.description: First Contentful Paint · first visible content

TTFB.label: TTFB
TTFB.description: Time to First Byte · document response

FID.label: FID
FID.description: First Input Delay · legacy metric, off by default

browserDiagnostics.title: Browser diagnostics
browserDiagnostics.description: Optional measurements for resource loading, sampled input latency, frame gaps and document navigation. Interval aggregates appear in the existing charts and captures.

collection.label: Collect browser diagnostics
collection.description: Off by default. Enabled groups collect only while the performance panel, capture or HUD requests sampling. Values stay local; this does not enable remote reporting.

browserDiagnostics.persistenceError: Your choices apply now but could not be saved for your next visit. Turning collection off still takes effect immediately.

resources.label: Resources
resources.description: Resource count, duration p95 and browser-visible transfer bytes. Transfer sizes are incomplete across origins and are not total network usage.

interactions.label: Interactions
interactions.description: Event Timing entries of at least 16 ms: count, input delay p95 and processing p95. This sample is not INP or a count of all interactions.

frames.label: Frame gaps
frames.description: Frame gap p95 and visible frame gaps over 50 ms. Hidden-window gaps are excluded; slow frames use this 50 ms threshold.

navigation.label: Navigation
navigation.description: Loading phases for the current document. Client-side route changes do not create a new document navigation.

navigation.title: Document navigation
navigation.description: DNS, connection, TLS, request and response are phase durations. DOM and load milestones are elapsed time from navigation start. A missing value may be pending or hidden by the browser.

browserDiagnostics.lifecycleHint: Settings apply to this device or browser. Disabling collection or a group stops its observers and clears pending samples and its current summary. Existing captures remain. No resource URLs, element details or input text are collected. Resource, event and frame-gap p95 values are unavailable when an interval exceeds 500 valid samples; counts and visible byte totals are still recorded.

operations.title: Application operations
operations.description: Find slow startup, storage, host calls and HTTP requests. These fixed operation summaries stay in this window’s memory.

collection.label: Collect application operations
collection.description: Off by default. Once enabled, selected groups record while you use the app, even with this panel closed. No remote reporting is enabled.

startup.label: Startup
startup.description: Startup capability probe. Enable and reload to measure the next startup.

storage.label: Storage
storage.description: Chat history reads and writes, and session lists. Write duration includes queue waiting and the write call, not outer transaction commit.

transport.label: Host calls
transport.description: Local and remote routed host calls. Performance sampling and telemetry calls are excluded.

network.label: Network
network.description: Requests through the app’s platform fetch. Browser duration ends when headers arrive; native duration includes buffered response data. HTTP failures count as errors.

operations.persistenceError: Your choices apply now but could not be saved for your next visit. Turning collection off still takes effect immediately.
operations.lifecycleHint: Switches apply to this device or browser. Turning a group off clears its data and stops recording immediately. Account or host changes clear statistics. Only fixed operation names, durations and outcomes are recorded; no content, identifiers, URLs or arguments.
operations.statisticsHint: Completed, error and cancellation counts are cumulative since clear. Duration statistics use the latest 120 valid completions per operation, including failures and cancellations. Chart counts cover each sampling interval; interval p95 is unavailable above 500 valid samples. Nested operations may overlap, so durations must not be added.
operations.dropped: {count} operations were not recorded because the 256 concurrent-operation limit was reached.
operations.empty: No selected operations recorded yet. Use the app, then return to this panel.
